profile_name: Standard Passenger Car Functional Unit — ICE/CNG (150,000 km)
maintenance_assumptions: Formula: lifetime_distance_km ÷ fuel_economy × fuel_factor. Separate tailpipe combustion from upstream fuel production.
replacement_parts_notes: Include tyres, 12V lead-acid battery, engine oil/fluids, replacement parts and AC refrigerant leakage where data and boundaries support inclusion.
operating_conditions: Indian urban/highway mixed cycle; state whether ARAI/MIDC test-cycle or real-world on-road consumption is used.

profile_name: Standard Passenger Car Functional Unit — BEV (150,000 km)
maintenance_assumptions: Formula: lifetime_distance_km × electricity_consumption (kWh/km) × grid_factor (kg CO2e/kWh). Include charging losses if wall-to-wheel.
replacement_parts_notes: Tyres, 12V auxiliary lead-acid battery, cabin filter, coolant/brake fluid, refrigerant leakage. Verify if traction battery replacement occurs within 150,000 km.
operating_conditions: Use real-world or test-cycle data consistently and record which it is (HVAC load in Indian summer affects real-world Wh/km).

profile_name: Standard Passenger Car Functional Unit — HEV/PHEV (150,000 km)
maintenance_assumptions: Model electric kilometres (lifetime_km × UF) and combustion kilometres (lifetime_km × (1 - UF)) separately.
replacement_parts_notes: Tyres, 12V battery, engine fluids, brake pads (reduced wear due to regen braking).
operating_conditions: PHEV results depend strongly on electric utility factor (UF) and user charging behaviour.
